topic: Model Context Protocol (MCP) — connecting AI assistants to your data
hook: AI assistants are trapped behind information silos.

sections.voiceover: AI assistants are trapped behind information silos.
sections.visual_cue: Kinetic typography: the words land center screen, one phrase at a time, on a flat dark background.
sections.animation_cue: Kinetic text slide-in and scale, opacity reveal
sections.claim: AI assistants are constrained by isolation from data and information silos.
sections.source: Anthropic, "Introducing the Model Context Protocol," Nov 25 2024

sections.voiceover: Anthropic's Model Context Protocol is one open standard connecting AI to your data.
sections.visual_cue: Article-highlight card: marker stroke draws across the key phrase as the narrator reads it, source URL on card.
sections.sfx_cue: Subtle bass drop on highlight completion
sections.animation_cue: Card fade-in, marker stroke left-to-right, hold
sections.claim: MCP is a universal, open standard for connecting AI systems with data sources.
sections.source: Anthropic, "Introducing the Model Context Protocol," Nov 25 2024

sections.voiceover: An MCP server exposes your data; an MCP client like Claude connects to it.
sections.visual_cue: Animated diagram: an MCP client node connects through a connector line to an MCP server node, which connects to data sources.
sections.animation_cue: Connectors draw on via evolvePath, node highlight push-in
sections.claim: Developers expose data through MCP servers or build MCP clients that connect to them.
sections.source: modelcontextprotocol.io, What is the Model Context Protocol?

sections.voiceover: Pre-built MCP servers exist for Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Postgres and Puppeteer.
sections.visual_cue: Terminal insert: character-by-character typing of an MCP server stdio config block, blinking cursor.

text_overlay.text: GOOGLE DRIVE · SLACK · GITHUB · POSTGRES · PUPPETEER

sections.claim: Anthropic shares pre-built MCP servers for Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Git, Postgres and Puppeteer.
sections.source: Anthropic, "Introducing the Model Context Protocol," Nov 25 2024

sections.voiceover: Build once, integrate everywhere. AI finally reaches your data.
sections.visual_cue: Summary card: the diagram settles to a stable center composition, credits at bottom left.
sections.animation_cue: Final push-in to diagram center, hold
sections.claim: MCP lets AI systems build once and integrate everywhere, reaching the data where it lives.
